effects.Chorus (system): a shared chorus every part sends to (CC93)
effects.Controller matrix (GS 40 2x, GM2 09 0s): what the wheels, aftertouch and two CCs move
effects.Delay (system): shared echoes every part sends to (CC94)
effects.EQ (system): low and high shelves on the whole mix
effects.Reverb (system): the room every part sends to (CC91)

efx.2 Pitch Shifter: two shifted copies: harmonies or detune
efx.3 Tap Delay: three echoes: centre, left and right
efx.3D Auto: the sound circling around the listener
efx.3D Chorus: a chorus placed beyond the speakers
efx.3D Manual: the sound placed anywhere around the listener
efx.4 Tap Delay: four echoes spread across the field
efx.Auto Pan: the sound moving between the speakers
efx.Auto Wah: a resonant filter swept by an LFO and by playing
efx.Bass Multi: compressor, overdrive, EQ and chorus, for bass
efx.Cho / Delay: chorus and echoes side by side
efx.Cho / Flanger: chorus and flanger side by side
efx.Clean Gt Multi 1: compressor, EQ, chorus and delay, clean guitar
efx.Clean Gt Multi 2: auto wah, EQ, chorus and delay, clean guitar
efx.Compressor: evens out the level: loud notes held down
efx.Distortion: overdrive with more gain: hard clipping
efx.Enhancer: adds brightness: the highs saturated and mixed back
efx.FL / Delay: flanger and echoes side by side
efx.Fb P.Shifter: a shifted echo that climbs as it repeats
efx.GTR Multi 1: compressor, overdrive, chorus and delay for guitar
efx.GTR Multi 2: compressor, overdrive and EQ, chorus, for guitar
efx.GTR Multi 3: compressor, overdrive and wah, for guitar
efx.Gate Reverb: a short, cut-off reverb: the 80s drum sound
efx.Hexa Chorus: six chorus voices spread in delay, depth and pan
efx.Humanizer: a talking filter: the formants of a vowel
efx.Keyboard Multi: ring modulator, EQ, pitch shift, phaser, delay
efx.Limiter: holds the peaks under a ceiling
efx.Lo-Fi 1: fewer bits and a lower rate: gritty
efx.Lo-Fi 2: lo-fi with a radio's or a record's noises
efx.Overdrive: a valve pushed into soft clipping, through a 1x12
efx.Phaser: a sweeping notch, the classic swirl
efx.Reverb: a room's reverberation, on this part alone
efx.Rhodes Multi: enhancer, phaser, chorus and tremolo, for keys
efx.Rotary: a Leslie speaker: horn and drum spinning
efx.Rotary Multi: overdrive and EQ into a Leslie
efx.Space D: a multi-tap chorus, wide and smooth
efx.Spectrum: eight fixed bands, a graphic equaliser
efx.Step Flanger: a flanger that moves in steps
efx.Stereo Chorus: a chorus on two sides, a wide shimmer
efx.Stereo Delay: echoes left and right, ping-pong if you like
